group: No schemas, OpenAPI3 discriminator disabled

cases.description: The validator has an empty schema list. No discriminator handling is enabled, so the method should skip the loop, not add any errors and finally return an empty set.

group: TypeValidator mismatch – schema ignored

cases.expected: Set containing one ValidationMessage produced by TypeValidator.validate
cases.description: The schema has a non‑UNION TypeValidator that does not match the node type. The validator should call TypeValidator.validate, add its message to allErrors, continue to the next schema (there is only one), and finally return the collected error.

group: Valid subschema, walk disabled, OpenAPI3 disabled – early success

cases.description: State.isWalkEnabled() returns false, schema.validate() returns an empty set, and the validator state reports that a node has already been matched (state.hasMatchedNode() == true). Because OpenAPI3 discriminators are disabled, the method clears allErrors and returns the empty set immediately.

group: Valid subschema, walk enabled, OpenAPI3 disabled – early success after walk

cases.description: State.isWalkEnabled() returns true, schema.walk() returns an empty set, state.hasMatchedNode() is true. With OpenAPI3 discriminators disabled the method clears allErrors and returns the empty set.

group: OpenAPI3 discriminator match found, errors present

cases.expected: Set containing original error(s) plus a DISCRIMINATOR_REMARK ValidationMessage
cases.description: OpenAPI3 style discriminators are enabled and discriminatorContext.isDiscriminatorMatchFound() returns true. The subschema validation produces errors. The method must add those errors, append the discriminator remark, and return the (non‑empty) error set.

group: OpenAPI3 discriminator match found, no errors

cases.description: OpenAPI3 discriminators enabled, discriminator match found, but the subschema validates without errors. The method clears allErrors and returns an empty set.

group: After loop – required‑error filtering removes all non‑required errors

cases.description: Two subschemas are evaluated: one fails with a REQUIRED error, the other passes (no errors). numberOfValidSubSchemas >= 1 and after filtering out REQUIRED errors the remaining set is empty, so allErrors becomes empty. Because OpenAPI3 discriminators are disabled, the method returns the empty set.

group: After loop – required‑error filtering leaves non‑required errors

cases.description: One subschema returns a REQUIRED error, another returns a different error (e.g., MIN_LENGTH). numberOfValidSubSchemas is 0, so the method does not clear errors. After filtering, childNotRequiredErrors contains the non‑required error, which is kept in the final result.

group: OpenAPI3 discriminator active but no match – final discriminator message

cases.expected: Set containing a single ValidationMessage with text 'based on the provided discriminator. No alternative could be chosen based on the discriminator property'
cases.description: OpenAPI3 discriminators are enabled and discriminatorContext.isActive() returns true, but no discriminator match was found during schema iteration. After the loop the method must return the specific 'no alternative could be chosen' message.

group: Final block – allErrors empty triggers state.setMatchedNode(true)

cases.expected: empty Set<ValidationMessage> and verifier that executionContext.getValidatorState().setMatchedNode(true) was called once
cases.description: All subschemas validate without errors, resulting in an empty allErrors set. The finally block must set the validator state matchedNode flag to true and merge the dynamic scopes.

group: Union TypeValidator bypasses type check

cases.description: The schema's TypeValidator reports JsonType.UNION. The validator must skip the type‑mismatch check, invoke the schema's validate() (which returns an empty set), clear allErrors and return an empty set. No TypeValidator.validate call should be made.

group: Schema without TypeValidator proceeds to validation

cases.description: The schema returns null from getTypeValidator(). The validator should directly call schema.validate() (which yields an empty set), treat the subschema as valid, clear any accumulated errors and return an empty set.

group: Valid subschema plus non‑required error from another schema – non‑required error retained

cases.expected: Set containing the MIN_LENGTH ValidationMessage from the second subschema
cases.description: Two subschemas are present. The first validates successfully (state.hasMatchedNode() becomes true, numberOfValidSubSchemas increments). The second returns a non‑required error (e.g., MIN_LENGTH). After the loop, childNotRequiredErrors is not empty, therefore the validator must keep all accumulated errors. The final set should contain only the MIN_LENGTH error.

group: Null executionContext

cases.description: The method dereferences executionContext immediately (executionContext.getCollectorContext()). Passing a null executionContext should cause a NullPointerException.

group: Null node parameter

cases.description: When node is null, the call to typeValidator.equalsToSchemaType(node) (or schema.validate) will throw a NullPointerException.

group: Null instanceLocation with OpenAPI3 discriminator enabled

cases.description: When OpenAPI3 style discriminators are enabled, the method calls executionContext.enterDiscriminatorContext(this.discriminatorContext, instanceLocation). Passing a null instanceLocation should cause a NullPointerException inside the execution context implementation.

group: OpenAPI3 discriminator enabled but null discriminatorContext

cases.description: If the validator is configured for OpenAPI3 style discriminators but its discriminatorContext field is null, the call executionContext.enterDiscriminatorContext(this.discriminatorContext, …) will throw a NullPointerException.

group: Schemas list contains null element

cases.description: AnyOfValidator holds a List<JsonSchema> that may contain a null entry. When the loop reaches that entry, calling schema.getTypeValidator() will throw a NullPointerException.

group: Schema.validate returns null

cases.description: If a subschema's validate method returns null instead of a Set, the subsequent call errors.isEmpty() will throw a NullPointerException.

group: Schema.walk returns null

cases.description: When walk is enabled and the subschema's walk method returns null, the later errors.isEmpty() call triggers a NullPointerException.

group: Null CollectorContext

cases.description: If executionContext.getCollectorContext() returns null, the first call to collectorContext.enterDynamicScope() will cause a NullPointerException.

group: Null ValidatorState

cases.description: When executionContext.getValidatorState() returns null, any subsequent call to state.hasMatchedNode() or state.setMatchedNode(...) will throw a NullPointerException.
